review_candidates.title: Senior Infrastructure Architect - Mainframe & Database Platforms
review_candidates.description: About The Role As a Senior Infrastructure Architect , you will provide technical leadership and architecture expertise across enterprise mainframe and database platforms, including IMS, IDMS, Datacom, DB2, and z/OS . You will design and support secure, resilient, and scalable infrastructure solutions that enable mission-critical business services while ensuring operational excellence, performance optimization, and compliance with enterprise technology standards. In this role, you will Design and implement end-to-end infrastructure solutions across IMS, IDMS, Datacom, DB2, and z/OS environments that align with enterprise architecture standards and business objectives. Lead the integration of mainframe databases and z/OS subsystems to ensure high availability, reliability, scalability, and performance. Provide advanced technical guidance for IMS administration, including configuration, maintenance, troubleshooting, performance tuning, and incident resolution. Manage IDMS environments, optimizing resource utilization, database regions, and data access strategies to support business-critical workloads. Administer Datacom environments, including schema management, backup and recovery processes, and performance optimization initiatives. Oversee z/OS administration activities, including system configuration, workload management, security controls, and capacity planning. Perform DB2 system administration tasks, including subsystem configuration, storage management, performance tuning, and optimization of database operations. Partner with development, engineering, and operations teams to translate business needs into scalable infrastructure solutions. Implement monitoring, alerting, and reporting capabilities to proactively identify issues and support capacity management decisions. Coordinate infrastructure changes and releases through controlled deployment processes and impact assessments. Lead the resolution of complex incidents, conduct root cause analysis, and implement preventative measures to improve platform stability. Develop and maintain architecture documentation, operational procedures, configuration standards, and technical runbooks. Provide recommendations for security hardening, compliance adherence, and data protection strategies across supported platforms. We believe hybrid work is the way forward as we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role’s business requirements, this is a hybrid position requiring 3 days a week in a client or Cognizant office Hartford, CT city, state. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance though our various wellbeing programs. The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you’re engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations. What You Need To Have To Be Considered Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience. Extensive experience administering and supporting enterprise mainframe environments. Strong hands-on expertise with IMS, IDMS, Datacom, DB2, and z/OS platforms. Experience designing highly available and scalable infrastructure architectures. Proven experience with performance tuning, capacity planning, monitoring, and incident management. Strong understanding of mainframe database administration, backup and recovery processes, and system optimization techniques. Experience working within enterprise change management and release management frameworks. Knowledge of infrastructure security, compliance requirements, and risk management principles. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. These will help you stand out Experience supporting large-scale enterprise or global mainframe environments. Knowledge of automation and operational efficiency tools within z/OS ecosystems. Experience implementing observability, monitoring, and performance management solutions. Familiarity with regulatory compliance frameworks and security best practices. Experience mentoring technical teams and providing architecture leadership across multiple initiatives. Salary And Other Compensation Applications will be accepted until November 5, 2026. The annual salary for this position is between $88,000 - $130,000 depending on experience and other qualifications of the successful candidate. This position is also eligible for Cognizant’s discretionary annual incentive program, based on performance and subject to the terms of Cognizant’s applicable plans. review_candidates.description: Blackstone is the world’s largest alternative asset manager. Blackstone seeks to deliver compelling returns for institutional and individual investors by strengthening the companies in which the firm invests. Blackstone’s over $1.3 trillion in assets under management include global investment strategies focused on real estate, private equity, credit, infrastructure, life sciences, growth equity, secondaries and hedge funds. Further information is available at www.blackstone.com. Follow @blackstone on LinkedIn, X (Twitter), and Instagram. Business Description Blackstone Technology & Innovations (BXTI) is the technology organization at the core of Blackstone’s businesses and growth initiatives. We design and deliver enterprise platforms and services that manage risk, create efficiency, and improve transparency across the firm and its global community of investors and portfolio companies. BXTI operates with an entrepreneurial mindset—collaborative, fast‑moving, and outcome‑driven—while maintaining the rigor required to support a complex global enterprise. We value leadership, accountability, and continuous improvement, and we expect our leaders to help the firm maintain its competitive edge. Job Description Blackstone Technology & Innovations (BXTI) is seeking a highly experienced and strategic Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery Leader to establish, drive, and continuously grow the firm’s technology resilience capabilities across infrastructure, applications, platforms, cloud services, and end-user technology. This role is responsible for ensuring that technology services can withstand, respond to, and recover from operational disruptions, cyber incidents, infrastructure failures, third-party outages, and other business-impacting events. This role includes being accountable for the overarching frameworks, processes, recovery strategies, and governance structures, while working closely with each technology tower to ensure adherence to program. Reporting into the firm’s Enterprise Technology function with a dotted line into the firm’s global Business Continuity Leader, this position owns technology recovery readiness across the technology estate and serves as the primary leader for technology continuity and disaster recovery governance. The successful candidate will build a culture of resilience, establish measurable recovery capabilities, drive accountability with service owners, and ensure that continuity planning evolves alongside the firm’s technology modernization efforts. Key Responsibilities Technology Resilience Strategy & Governance Develop and maintain the technology resilience strategy, roadmap, standards, and operating model. Establish governance frameworks, policies, and controls that align business continuity, disaster recovery, operational resilience, cyber recovery, and crisis management capabilities. Define technology resilience metrics, key risk indicators, and executive reporting. Ensure resilience requirements are embedded into architecture reviews, platform design decisions, cloud adoption initiatives, and technology transformation programs. Drive continuous improvement based on testing outcomes, incidents, audits, and emerging threats. Technology Recovery Planning Ensure and track that every critical application, platform, infrastructure service, and technology team has documented, maintained, and approved recovery plans. Establish standards for Recovery Time Objectives (RTOs), Recovery Point Objectives (RPOs), service criticality classifications, recovery dependencies, and minimum viable operating levels. Support the maintenance and validation of a technology service inventory that maps applications, infrastructure, cloud services, vendors, and business dependencies. Ensure all service owners understand their recovery obligations and remain accountable for plan quality and readiness. Drive collaboration with Business Units, Corporate Functions, and individual offices to prepare for BCP events based on specific needs of impacted groups, teams, and locations. Work with the firm’s Chief Architect to validate that recovery architectures, failover capabilities, backup solutions, and resiliency patterns meet business requirements. Partner with engineering and infrastructure teams to identify individual points of failure and remediation priorities. Drive technology resilience requirements into platform lifecycle management and modernization efforts. Support internal audits, risk assessments, client due diligence requests, and regulatory reviews related to resilience and recovery preparedness. Establish reporting processes that provide visibility into preparedness, testing results, residual risks, and remediation progress. Testing & Exercising Develop and maintain a comprehensive testing program for all critical technology services. Establish standards for tabletop exercises, simulation exercises, technical failover tests, cyber recovery exercises, and full-scale disaster recovery events. Ensure each technology domain maintains documented test schedules, test plans, results, lessons learned, and remediation actions. Facilitate executive and technology leadership participation in crisis simulations and recovery exercises. Track remediation actions through completion and validate risk reduction outcomes. Operational Resilience & Crisis Management Serve as the technology point of contact during major incidents and crisis events. Coordinate cross-functional technology recovery efforts during disruptive events. Partner with Cyber Security, Infrastructure, Cloud, Operations, and Engineering teams during incidents and technology outages. Support executive crisis management teams with impact assessment, recovery planning, and readiness reporting. Provide clear executive-level communications regarding technology recovery status, risks, and dependencies. Required Experience 10+ years of experience in technology risk, resilience, disaster recovery, infrastructure operations, technology governance, cybersecurity, or enterprise technology leadership. Demonstrated experience leading large-scale BCP/DR or operational resilience programs within a complex enterprise environment. Strong understanding of disaster recovery, business continuity management, operational resilience, cyber recovery, incident command structures, cloud recovery architectures, infrastructure resilience, and technology risk management.
